entities.summary: Wuxi IFS is a late-modernist supertall skyscraper in Wuxi, China. The mixed-use tower has a height of 339 metres (1,112 ft) and contain 68 floors. Construction of the 280,000-square-metre (3,014,000 sq ft) glass and steel-building was completed in 2014.
